label: Warn the owner once a day when the disk is filling up
description: Recordings are the only thing a hosted portal pays for. Once a day, if free disk is below the number here, the owner is told — by email when mail is set up, as a banner when it is not.

params.name: min_free_mb
params.label: Warn below this much free disk (MB)

then.subject: Disk is filling up: {disk_free_mb} MB free
then.text:
Only {disk_free_mb} MB of disk is free; the portal's data folder holds {data_mb} MB.
Open Admin → Storage to see who holds what, or raise the disk.
